estiloVisual: Cinematic, photorealistic, shot in Cali, Colombia, humble working-class home and places, shallow depth of field, soft film grain, natural acting, slow subtle camera movement, vertical framing with the faces in the upper-middle of the frame.

voz.estilo: narradora de un comercial colombiano, mujer de Cali, con voz cálida y cercana y acento colombiano natural

musica.prompt: Emotional cinematic score for a 40-second Colombian TV commercial about health and family. First 18 seconds: soft, sad solo piano with gentle low strings, sparse and intimate, slow (around 70 BPM). Then a warm, hopeful lift: piano becomes brighter, soft strings and a light acoustic guitar join, building gently to an uplifting, reassuring ending with a soft resolved final chord. No drums at the start, no vocals. Instrumental only, no vocals.

referencias.prompt: A Colombian mother, about 32 years old, from Cali, warm medium-brown skin, dark curly hair tied in a low messy ponytail, kind tired eyes, no makeup, small gold stud earrings, wearing a faded mustard-yellow cotton t-shirt and grey leggings. Next to her, her son, about 5 years old, short curly black hair, wearing light blue cotton pajamas with small white stars. Both looking at the camera.

escenas.voz: Dos de la mañana. Mateo con fiebre… y su mamá sin EPS.
escenas.tono: en voz baja, íntima y pausada, con angustia contenida

toma.prompt: Night. Opens on a close-up of the mother's face lit by the soft glow of her phone screen, a concerned, thoughtful expression. The camera slowly pulls back to reveal a cozy, humble bedroom with blue moonlight through the window and a warm bedside lamp, where her son sleeps peacefully under a blanket with a small white towel folded on his forehead. She puts the phone down and gently strokes his hair.
toma.sonido: quiet night ambience, a clock ticking

escenas.voz: En urgencias lo atienden, sí. Pero después vienen los exámenes, las citas, los medicamentos… y no tenía EPS.
escenas.tono: seria, a ritmo de conversación normal, con una pausa breve antes de «y no tenía EPS»

toma.prompt: Early morning at a public hospital in Cali, fluorescent lights, a few people waiting. The mother, same mustard-yellow t-shirt, stands at the admissions window holding a few papers, reading them with a worried face; her son sits on a plastic chair behind her wrapped in a small blanket, calm and sleepy. Handheld camera, documentary feel.
toma.sonido: hospital waiting room murmur, distant beeping

escenas.voz: Todo porque la pensión no le alcanzaba.
escenas.tono: lenta y triste, casi en susurro al final

toma.prompt: Night, a small humble kitchen with a single warm hanging bulb. The mother sits alone at a wooden table, same mustard-yellow t-shirt, looking at a few Colombian peso bills and coins next to a pharmacy receipt. She covers her mouth with her hand and lets out a quiet sigh, eyes glassy. Static camera, slow and still.
toma.sonido: quiet kitchen, refrigerator hum, coins on wood

escenas.voz: Con BRYGAR hay EPS sin pensión: ciento veinticinco mil al mes, todo incluido. Y Mateo también queda cubierto.
escenas.tono: con un tono luminoso y esperanzador, más ágil y segura, sonriendo

toma.prompt: Bright warm morning sunlight in the same humble living room. The mother, same mustard-yellow t-shirt, sits on the sofa typing a message on her phone; her face changes from doubt to relief and a soft smile. Her son, now healthy, in his light blue star pajamas, climbs next to her and hugs her arm. Gentle slow dolly-in, hopeful warm tones.

escenas.pantalla: Con BRYGAR hay EPS sin pensión: $125.000 al mes, todo incluido. Y Mateo también queda cubierto.

escenas.voz: Te afiliamos el mismo día. Y si estás al día y por tu afiliación no te dan la cita o los medicamentos, te devolvemos el cien por ciento del mes.
escenas.tono: firme, segura y ágil, como una promesa, sin pausas largas

toma.prompt: Daytime in a clean, bright medical office in Cali. A friendly doctor in a white coat finishes checking the boy, healthy and smiling, sitting on the examination bed in a t-shirt; the doctor gives him a playful high five. The mother, same mustard-yellow t-shirt, receives a prescription from the doctor and smiles with relief. Warm natural light, slow camera movement.
toma.sonido: soft clinic ambience, the boy laughs softly

escenas.pantalla: Te afiliamos el mismo día. Y si estás al día y por tu afiliación no te dan la cita o los medicamentos, te devolvemos el 100 % del mes.
